data.caution: There is a special risk. Follow the packaging instructions and use a suitable handler. Never dump hazardous items. Wash it before using it again. Normal washing doesn't deal with chemical or biological contamination. Don't reuse cracked or broken glass or ceramics.
data.reason: You marked a special risk but didn't say which kind. Choose the risk type so ordinary dirt isn't treated as hazardous contamination.

source_details.scope_note: Don't mix or dump chemical waste. Follow the label and ask your local handler.
source_details.title: Household Hazardous Waste: safe management

steps: Check the label and the type of risk without opening the item, mixing contents, or trying to treat it.
Don't reuse a risky item or mix it with general waste until you know what the hazard is.
Contact your local waste handler or environment agency and describe the item and any known risks.
